pattern.short_summary: Two or more physically distinct input channels — typed text, drawn marks, speech, pointing, body pose, GUI controls — are accepted for the same operation.
pattern.definition: Two or more physically distinct input channels — typed text, drawn marks, speech, pointing, body pose, GUI controls — are accepted for the same operation. They are either fused into one request or freely interchangeable within a single interaction, without a mode change.
pattern.structural_signature: The input side of one operation has at least two capture channels feeding a single request object, and the system must fuse or arbitrate between them. The user can switch channels mid-operation without transitioning the interface to a different state, so channel choice is not a mode.

dimension.category_description: How interaction crosses sensory, physical, spatial, embodied, or representational channels.
dimension.classification_boundary: The channel, embodiment, or rendering must be the load-bearing interface mechanism.
